description: Source code for RPM calculation in engine control firmware, including RPM measurement, engine state detection, trigger event handling, and scheduling of engine-related callbacks.

classes.name: RpmCalculator
classes.description: Class responsible for calculating engine RPM, managing engine state, and handling trigger events.

methods.name: getRpmAcceleration
methods.description: Calculates the acceleration of RPM based on previous and current RPM values.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Checks if the engine is currently stopped.

methods.name: isCranking
methods.description: Checks if the engine is in cranking state.

methods.name: isSpinningUp
methods.description: Checks if the engine is in the process of spinning up.

methods.name: getRevolutionCounterSinceStart
methods.description: Returns the number of shaft revolutions since start.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the engine is running.

methods.name: checkIfSpinning
methods.description: Determines if the engine is spinning based on recent trigger events.

methods.name: assignRpmValue
methods.description: Assigns a new RPM value and updates related parameters.

methods.name: setRpmValue
methods.description: Sets RPM value and updates engine state accordingly.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current engine spinning state.

methods.name: onNewEngineCycle
methods.description: Updates counters on a new engine cycle.

methods.name: setSpinningUp
methods.description: Sets engine to spinning up state.
